label: Lost the story
title: Dress the Hire
dek: In 1799 some insiders needed a general for a job. Napoleon was their third pick. Cut out the hire and his wardrobe and dress him for every stage of the coup. It’s all drawn to scale. It fits.
summary: A cut-out paper doll of Napoleon with outfits for each stage of the 1799 Brumaire coup, from his return from Egypt to the founding of the Banque de France.

blocks.text: Ed’s mom’s favorite page! (her words)

items: Fold tabs back. Fouché will look away.

blocks.title: Now Hiring · Paris · 1799 — Wanted: One (1) Sword

blocks.text: Must come with soldiers who follow orders. No party? No money? Even better.
Apply to E. Sieyès, Director, who is overthrowing his own government.
Applicant No. 3
NOT SHORT. Measured in bond prices, he grew from 7 to 20 in seven weeks. That’s the chart the money men were watching.
The Wardrobe
Hat No. 3. Hats No. 1 and 2 were unavailable. One was killed in battle. One said no.
The General’s Coat. Lightly used. Last owner walked away from his own army in Egypt.
The Newspapers. Courtesy of a British naval officer. All bad news. Read, then leave for the general you abandon.
Fouché’s Report. Mentions the coup “not one word.” Goes with everything.
The Sword. The entire original order. Sieyès was “looking for a sword.” He got the guy attached to it.
One Bond. About 7 francs in late Sept. 20 within a week of the coup. Somebody bet while it was happening.
The Consul Coat. A job share for three. Within weeks, Sieyès got pushed aside. HR was not consulted.
The Wreath. He applied for the job. Within five years, he applied this.
The Banker’s Hat. Not his? His name was first on the bank’s shareholder list.
Lucien, 24. The inside man. Sword aimed at his brother’s chest, as on day two. Not to scale. He’s the little brother.
The Bank Key. Not for him. Leave it on the table for the men in the top hats.
The Looks
A career in five outfits

items: Oct. 9, 1799 — Off the Boat. Hat 3 · coat · news. No party. No money. Bad news. Hired.
18 Brumaire — As Ordered. Hat · coat · sword. Exactly what was ordered. Lasts one day.
Day Two — The Near Miss. Coat · sword · Lucien. Nearly outlawed. Add one little brother.
Within 5 Years — The Twist. Consul coat · wreath. Hired as a sword. Not going back in the case.
Meanwhile — The Bankers. Top hat · key · bond. He took the throne. They kept the bank.

blocks.text: BONUS ROUND: Find the coup in Fouché’s police report. (A historian tried. “Not one word.”)
